name: mod-menu
description: Owns /mod-menu, which hides or shows the panel pills above the prompt; each panel mod draws its own entry there

labels.title: Menu labels
labels.description: auto draws each pill with its icon and its name, and every pill drops to its icon alone when the row is wider than the window. always keeps the names, never draws the icons alone. Icons alone apply on Nerd Font icons only, since safe mode has no icon. /mod-menu labels auto|always|never sets it too
